data.title: Illinois Tax Preparer Sentenced for Stealing More than $11M from Taxpayers in COVID-19 Assistance Fraud Scheme
data.summary: An Illinois woman was sentenced on Friday to 36 months, two years of supervised release, and ordered to pay $11,130,490 in restitution and a forfeiture money judgment of $1,965,712, for running a multi-million-dollar pandemic assistance and unemployment benefits scheme.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/illinois-.label: Illinois Tax Preparer Sentenced for Stealing More than $11M from Taxpayers in COVID-19 Assistance Fraud Scheme

data.title: Three Iranian-Backed Operatives Indicted for Their Roles in Nearly 20 Terrorist Attacks and Attempted Attacks Across Europe and the United States
data.summary: An eight-count superseding indictment was unsealed today charging Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi, a dual Iranian-Iraqi national; Mohsen Mohajeri, an Iranian national; and Mohammad Ali al-Hassani, an Iraqi national, with terrorism-related offenses for their activities in support of Kata’ib Hizballah and Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), two U.S. designated foreign terrorist organizations (FTOs), including their involvement in nearly 20 attacks and attempted attacks throughout Europe and the United States, and a September 2026 terrorist plot at a British Royal Air Force Base in Fairford, United Kingdom, where American armed forces were stationed.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/three-ira.label: Three Iranian-Backed Operatives Indicted for Their Roles in Nearly 20 Terrorist Attacks and Attempted Attacks Across Europe and the United States

data.title: Social Adult Day Care Program Director Pleads Guilty to $127M Medicare and Medicaid Fraud Scheme
data.summary: A Queens man pleaded guilty on Monday to defrauding Medicare and New York State Medicaid of approximately $127 million by billing for medically unnecessary prescription drugs and social adult day care (SADC) services that were not provided.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/social-ad.label: Social Adult Day Care Program Director Pleads Guilty to $127M Medicare and Medicaid Fraud Scheme

data.title: Court Permanently Bars Florida Tax Return Preparer and Tax Preparation Business and Orders Disgorgement of More Than $550,000
data.summary: The U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida has permanently barred Juan Humberto Garcia and his tax preparation business, The Tax Master of BVL, Inc., from preparing federal tax returns for others and ordered them to pay $558,520. The court also barred Marcos Yariel Figueroa from preparing federal tax returns for others for two years.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/court-per.label: Court Permanently Bars Florida Tax Return Preparer and Tax Preparation Business and Orders Disgorgement of More Than $550,000

data.title: Idaho Man Sentenced to 18 Years in Prison for Attempting to Provide Material Support to ISIS in Plot to Attack Churches
data.summary: Alexander Scott Mercurio, 21, of Coeur d’Alene, Idaho, was sentenced today to 18 years in prison and lifetime supervised release by U.S. District Judge David C. Nye of the District of Idaho for attempting to provide material support and resources to a designated foreign terrorist organization.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/idaho-man.label: Idaho Man Sentenced to 18 Years in Prison for Attempting to Provide Material Support to ISIS in Plot to Attack Churches

data.title: New Jersey Tax Preparer Pleads Guilty to Filing False Tax Returns for Clients
data.summary: A New Jersey man pleaded guilty today to filing false tax returns for clients that caused an intended loss of $327,647 to the United States.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/new-jerse.label: New Jersey Tax Preparer Pleads Guilty to Filing False Tax Returns for Clients

data.title: Bergen County Orthopedic Surgeon Pleads Guilty to Employment Tax Crime
data.summary: A New Jersey orthopedic surgeon pleaded guilty to failing to pay over trust fund taxes.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/bergen-co.label: Bergen County Orthopedic Surgeon Pleads Guilty to Employment Tax Crime

data.title: Court Orders Atlanta Area Tax Return Preparer to Permanently Shut Down Tax Preparation Business
data.summary: The U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia issued a permanent injunction against tax return preparer Tanja D. Hollis, of Griffin, Georgia, and Hollis’s business, Tanja Tax Preparations, LLC. The injunction bars Hollis from acting as a return preparer, preparing tax returns or assisting others in the preparation of tax returns, engaging in conduct that substantially interferes with the proper administration and enforcement of the internal revenue laws and from promoting any false tax scheme.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/court-ord.label: Court Orders Atlanta Area Tax Return Preparer to Permanently Shut Down Tax Preparation Business

data.title: Dual Kazakhstani-Tajikistani Citizen Extradited from Egypt for Role in Alien Smuggling Conspiracy
data.summary: Abdulhafiz Bahovatdiny, 36, a dual Kazakhstani-Tajikistani citizen made his initial appearance in court in Phoenix, Arizona, today after being extradited from Egypt to face charges for his role in a human smuggling conspiracy.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/dual-kaza.label: Dual Kazakhstani-Tajikistani Citizen Extradited from Egypt for Role in Alien Smuggling Conspiracy

data.title: Justice Department Issues Fact Sheets About Lease Terminations for Servicemembers and their Dependents
data.summary: The Justice Department announced today that it has issued two fact sheets to help servicemembers, including those who are returning to civilian life as veterans, avoid unnecessary rent payments and costly fees. The first explains how servicemembers and their dependents can end a residential or business lease on receiving eligible military orders. And the second explains how they can end certain vehicle leases.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/justice-d.label: Justice Department Issues Fact Sheets About Lease Terminations for Servicemembers and their Dependents

data.title: New York Doctor Charged in $6.8M Medicare Fraud Scheme
data.summary: A federal grand jury in the Southern District of Florida returned an indictment on Tuesday charging Dr. Edgard Salazar, 57, of Armonk, New York, with conspiring to bill Medicare for thousands of consultations that never occurred and millions of dollars of orthotic braces that Medicare patients did not want or need.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/new-york-.label: New York Doctor Charged in $6.8M Medicare Fraud Scheme

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/gootloade.label: Gootloader Malware Disrupted in International Cyber Operation

data.title: Florida Missionary Indicted for Child Exploitation Crimes in Haiti
data.summary: A federal grand jury in the Southern District of Florida returned an indictment charging Thomas Osbeck, 70, of Ft. Myers, Florida, with engaging in, and attempting to engage in, illicit sexual conduct with minors in Haiti.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/florida-m.label: Florida Missionary Indicted for Child Exploitation Crimes in Haiti

data.title: Minnesota Man Pleads Guilty to Conspiring to Defraud IRS
data.summary: A Minnesota man pleaded guilty today to conspiring to defraud the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/minnesota.label: Minnesota Man Pleads Guilty to Conspiring to Defraud IRS

data.title: International Law Enforcement Operation Targeting Opioid and Fentanyl Traffickers on the Dark Web Results in over 350 Arrests Worldwide and the Seizure of Drugs, Weapons, and over $234 Million
data.summary: Today, the Department of Justice, through the Joint Criminal Opioid and Darknet Enforcement (JCODE) team, joined Europol to announce the results of Operation TorNado: a coordinated, multi‑agency and international law enforcement effort targeting criminal enterprises that use Dark Web markets to traffic fentanyl, opioids, and other illicit drugs

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/internati.label: International Law Enforcement Operation Targeting Opioid and Fentanyl Traffickers on the Dark Web Results in over 350 Arrests Worldwide and the Seizure of Drugs, Weapons, and over $234 Million

data.title: Justice Department Announces Actions to Disrupt North Korea’s Massive Theft of Cryptocurrency
data.summary: Today the Department of Justice announced coordinated actions against the Democratic People’s Republic of North Korea (DPRK) government’s schemes to fund its regime through the massive theft of cryptocurrency.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/justice-d.label: Justice Department Announces Actions to Disrupt North Korea’s Massive Theft of Cryptocurrency

data.title: Florida Man Sentenced for Stealing Millions of Dollars from Lenders Using Sham Cosmetic Surgery Clinics and Stolen Identities
data.summary: Today, A Wellington, Florida, man was sentenced today to 84 months in prison for using sham cosmetic surgery clinics and the stolen identities of more than 100 people to defraud medical lenders of approximately $2.3 million, and for fraudulently seeking COVID-19 disaster relief loans.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/florida-m.label: Florida Man Sentenced for Stealing Millions of Dollars from Lenders Using Sham Cosmetic Surgery Clinics and Stolen Identities

data.title: Florida Man Pleads Guilty to $42M Durable Medical Equipment and Cancer Genetic Testing Fraud on Medicare
data.summary: A Florida man pleaded guilty today to a $42 million fraud on Medicare involving false claims for durable medical equipment (DME) and cancer genetic testing. He also pled guilty to fraudulently obtaining a Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) loan.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/florida-m.label: Florida Man Pleads Guilty to $42M Durable Medical Equipment and Cancer Genetic Testing Fraud on Medicare

data.title: HVAC Supplier Johnson Controls Inc. and Two Subsidiaries Agree to Pay $5 Million to Settle Cybersecurity Fraud Allegations
data.summary: Johnson Controls, Inc., of Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and two subsidiaries, Johnson Controls Fire Protection LP and Johnson Controls Security Solutions LLC (collectively, “Johnson Controls”), have agreed to pay $5 million to resolve allegations that they violated the False Claims Act by failing to comply with cybersecurity requirements in their federal contracts and subcontracts for building products and services, including heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) services.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/hvac-supp.label: HVAC Supplier Johnson Controls Inc. and Two Subsidiaries Agree to Pay $5 Million to Settle Cybersecurity Fraud Allegations

data.title: Mexican Cartel Leader Known As “Tony Montana” Sentenced for Armed Drug Trafficking as Part of Homeland Security Task Force Initiative
data.summary: Antonio Oseguera Cervantes, 67, of Michoacán, Mexico, a career drug trafficker for several Mexican cartels, was sentenced today to 270 months in prison for international drug trafficking and firearm offenses.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/mexican-c.label: Mexican Cartel Leader Known As “Tony Montana” Sentenced for Armed Drug Trafficking as Part of Homeland Security Task Force Initiative

data.title: Federal Court in San Diego, California, Enters Permanent Injunction Barring Criminally Prosecuted Tax Preparer from Preparing Federal Tax Returns for Others
data.summary: The U.S. District Court for the Southern District of California has issued an order permanently barring Oladapo Olagbemi, who managed a San Diego-based tax return preparation business, from preparing federal tax returns for any person or entity other than himself, the Justice Department announced today. The injunction also bars Olagbemi from, among other things, owning any business involved in tax return preparation or training any person in the preparation of tax returns. Olagbemi consented to the civil injunction order.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/federal-c.label: Federal Court in San Diego, California, Enters Permanent Injunction Barring Criminally Prosecuted Tax Preparer from Preparing Federal Tax Returns for Others

data.title: Chiropractor and Former CEO Sentenced for Using Abusive Tax Shelter
data.summary: A Puerto Rico chiropractor, formerly of Westmont, Illinois, was sentenced last week to 15 months in prison for filing a false tax return in connection with his use of an illegal tax shelter. He was additionally sentenced to one year of supervised release and ordered to pay restitution of $1,295,663 and interest of $429,026.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/chiroprac.label: Chiropractor and Former CEO Sentenced for Using Abusive Tax Shelter

data.title: Former Honduran Consul General Charged and 3 Others Arrested in Alleged Bribery and Money Laundering Scheme
data.summary: Ada Evila Serrano Nuñez (Ada Serrano), the former Consul General of the Honduran Consulate in Atlanta, was arrested in Atlanta on charges alleging her participation in a bribery and money laundering scheme. The indictment, which was unsealed after her arrest, includes one count of conspiracy to violate the Foreign Extortion Prevention Act (FEPA), one count of violating FEPA, and one count of conspiracy to commit money laundering.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/former-ho.label: Former Honduran Consul General Charged and 3 Others Arrested in Alleged Bribery and Money Laundering Scheme

data.title: Alleged Member of “8-Digits Team” Ransomware Group Extradited from Italy for Role in Major Data Extortion Campaign Against U.S. Hospitals, Healthcare Entities, and Schools
data.summary: Roman Khlynovskiy, 43, a Kazak national, made his initial appearance in Knoxville, Tennessee, federal court today after being extradited from Italy to face charges for his alleged role in a ransomware and extortion conspiracy that targeted U.S. schools, hospitals, and healthcare entities.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/alleged-m.label: Alleged Member of “8-Digits Team” Ransomware Group Extradited from Italy for Role in Major Data Extortion Campaign Against U.S. Hospitals, Healthcare Entities, and Schools

data.title: JOINT STATEMENT FROM DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE AND DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE ON MEGASPEED INVESTIGATION
data.summary: The Department of Commerce and the Department of Justice are providing the public with an update on the investigation of the Singaporean company Megaspeed, which has attracted significant public attention in the last week. While we don’t typically comment on ongoing investigations, it is in the public interest to provide the facts and address inaccurate information circulating in public reporting.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/joint-sta.label: JOINT STATEMENT FROM DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE AND DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE ON MEGASPEED INVESTIGATION
